name: cavalier_of_gales_stolen_dies_shuffles_its_owners_library
notes: Printed: 'When this creature dies, shuffle it into its owner's library, then scry 2.' Seat 0 steals seat 1's Cavalier with Act of Treason and it dies under seat 0's control: the trigger is seat 0's (CR 603.3a), so seat 0 scries (both answers 'top', so seat 0's library keeps its order), but the library shuffled is the OWNER's, seat 1's, with the Cavalier in it (CR 108.3). Seat 0's library is not shuffled: it keeps its setup order exactly. Was red pack B08 of verification wave 1's G3 pass: SHUFFLE read the controller's library.
